args.sql:
WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT "customer_id", COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"
  GROUP BY "customer_id"
)
SELECT
  COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS repurchase_rate
FROM customer_orders

WITH customer_orders AS (
  SELECT "customer_id", COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"
  GROUP BY "customer_id"
)
SELECT order_cnt, COUNT(*) AS customer_count
FROM customer_orders
GROUP BY order_cnt
ORDER BY order_cnt

WITH customer_channel AS (
  SELECT "customer_id", "channel", COUNT(*) AS order_cnt
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"
  GROUP BY "customer_id", "channel"
)
SELECT "channel",
  COUNT(*) AS total_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS repeat_customers,
  SUM(CASE WHEN order_cnt >= 2 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 1.0 / COUNT(*) AS repurchase_rate
FROM customer_channel
GROUP BY "channel"
ORDER BY repurchase_rate DESC

events.result: {"total_datasources": 1, "total_rows_estimate": 1500, "datasources": [{"id": "f06afcec-b474-4721-8104-c371afab546a", "name": "ecommerce_orders", "type": "csv", "row_count": 1500, "columns": ["order_id", "order_date", "customer_id", "customer_name", "region", "city", "product_name", "category", "channel", "quantity", "unit_price", "amount", "payment_method", "status", "age_group", "gender", "first_order_date", "refund_date", "refund_amount"], "fields": ["order_id(VARCHAR)", "order_date(DATE)", "customer_id(VARCHAR)", "customer_name(VARCHAR)", "region(VARCHAR)", "city(VARCHAR)", "product_name(VARCHAR)", "category(VARCHAR)", "channel(VARCHAR)", "quantity(BIGINT)", "unit_price(DOUBLE)", "amount(DOUBLE)", "payment_method(VARCHAR)", "status(VARCHAR)", "age_group(VARCHAR)", "gender(VARCHAR)", "first_order_date(DATE)", "refund_date(DATE)", "refund_amount(DOUBLE)"], "table_ref": "\"ecommerce_orders_f06afcec\".\"data\"", "sample_sql": "SELECT * FROM \"ecommerce_orders_f06afcec\".\"data\" LIMIT 1"}], "tip": "查询前建议先用 sample_sql 执行 SELECT * LIMIT 1 看实际列名和数据格式，然后用 columns 数组中的列名写正式的聚合查询。FROM 用 table_ref，列名用双引号包裹。"}

args.sql:
WITH daily AS (
  SELECT "order_date" AS d, SUM("amount") AS sales
  FROM "ecommerce_orders_f06afcec"."data"
  GROUP BY "order_date"
), avg_daily AS (
  SELECT AVG(sales) AS avg_sales FROM daily
)
SELECT d AS 日期, sales AS 日销售额, avg_sales AS 平均日销售额, sales / avg_sales AS 占比
FROM daily, avg_daily
WHERE sales < avg_sales * 0.5
ORDER BY d
LIMIT 50
